message.content:
Build the Contact page and Book a Demo page for the Boldteq marketing site.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes. Never use `any` type. Read existing components first for patterns.

## Contact Page (`/contact`)

### `src/app/contact/page.tsx` (server component)
Export metadata: title "Contact Us | Boldteq", description "Get in touch with Boldteq...", path "/contact"

### `src/components/contact/contact-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
- Badge: "Get In Touch"
- H1: "Need any help? Contact us"
- Subtitle: "Full-service agency crafting digital experiences that leave a lasting impression."

### `src/components/contact/contact-info-cards.tsx` + `.module.css`
3 contact cards in a row:
1. Sales — sales@boldteq.com (mailto link)
2. Support — support@boldteq.com (mailto link)
3. Career — hr@boldteq.com (mailto link)
Each card has: an icon, department name, email, and an arrow link. White bg, subtle shadow.

### `src/components/contact/contact-form-section.tsx` + `.module.css`
"use client" component with a form.
- Title: "Send us a message."
- Fields: First Name, Last Name (side by side), Email, Phone, Service dropdown (Web Development, UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, App Development, Other), Message textarea
- Submit button: "Send Your Message" (gradient cyan)
- Form state: idle, submitting, success, error
- On submit: just log to console for now (TODO: integrate with API route)
- Success message: "Thank you! Your submission has been received!"
- Error message: "Oops! Something went wrong."
- Use existing `Input` and `Textarea` components from `src/components/ui/input.tsx` and `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx`

### Page composition:
```tsx
<ContactHero />
<ContactInfoCards />
<ContactFormSection />
```

---

## Book a Demo Page (`/book-a-demo`)

### `src/app/book-a-demo/page.tsx` (server component)
Export metadata: title "Book a Demo with Boldteq", description "See how Boldteq works as your white-label backend team...", path "/book-a-demo"

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
- Badge: "Book Demo"
- H1: "Book a Demo with Boldteq"
- Subtitle: "See how Boldteq works as your white-label backend team — and how agencies use our subscription model to deliver faster without hiring."
- 4 stat badges: "100% white-label" (icon `Layer_1-3.svg`), "Agency-only conversations" (`Layer_1-14.svg`), "No sales pressure" (`Layer_1-15.svg`), "15–30 minute walkthrough" (`Layer_1-16.svg`)
- CTA: "Schedule Your Demo" button → external link to `https://calendly.com/boldteq/schedule-demo`

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-covers.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "What We'll Cover in the Demo"
- Subtitle: "A focused walkthrough of how Boldteq operates as your white-label delivery partner..."
- 4 cards:
  1. Icon: `Layer_1-17.svg`, "Delivery Workflow", "How tasks move from request → execution → review → client-ready delivery."
  2. Icon: `Layer_1-18.svg`, "Subscription Model", "How our plans work, how capacity is handled, and how agencies scale."
  3. Icon: `Layer_1-8.svg`, "White-Label Operations", "How we stay invisible while supporting your client delivery."
  4. Icon: `Layer_1-19.svg`, "Real Use Cases", "How agencies use Boldteq for web, Shopify, UI/UX, and ongoing work."

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-audience.tsx` + `.module.css`
Navy background section: "Who This Demo Is Designed For"
- Left: heading + subtitle
- Right: "This Demo Is Ideal For:" + 5 benefits with blue tick icons:
  - Digital agencies managing ongoing client work
  - Shopify & WordPress agencies
  - UI/UX & branding studios
  - Founders scaling delivery without hiring
  - Teams looking for a reliable white-label partner

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-steps.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "How the Demo Works" — 4 numbered steps:
1. "Book a Time" — "Choose a time slot that works for you. No preparation required."
2. "Walkthrough" — "We walk you through our workflow, subscription plans, and delivery model, with space for your questions."
3. "Next Steps (If Needed)" — "If there's a fit, we'll discuss next steps. If not, that's completely fine — no pressure either way."
4. "Micro-Reassurance" — "No obligation and no pressure. The demo is simply a clear walkthrough to help you decide if Boldteq is the right fit."

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-why-boldteq.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Why Agencies Choose Boldteq"
- Badge: "Why Boldteq"
- Subtitle: "Our delivery model prioritizes consistency, accountability, and brand protection..."
- 4 cards:
  1. `Layer_1-8.svg`, "White-Label by Default", "We operate entirely under your brand..."
  2. `Layer_1-20.svg`, "Senior-Level Team", "Work is handled by experienced professionals..."
  3. `Layer_1-10.svg`, "Structured Delivery", "Clear systems, defined ownership..."
  4. `Layer_1-21.svg`, "Built for Agencies", "Everything about Boldteq is designed around agency workflows..."

### `src/components/book-a-demo/demo-book-cta.tsx` + `.module.css`
Bottom CTA section:
- Left: "Book a Demo" badge + "See How Boldteq Can Power Your Agency's Growth" + paragraph + email contact info (sales@boldteq.com)
- Right: Large "Schedule Your Demo" CTA button linking to Calendly
- Trust badges: "No credit card", "15-min call", "Cancel anytime"

### Page composition:
```tsx
<DemoHero />
<DemoCovers />
<DemoAudience />
<DemoSteps />
<DemoWhyBoldteq />
<DemoBookCta />
```

**Key references to read:**
- `src/components/how-it-works/process-steps.tsx` — numbered steps pattern (reuse for demo-steps)
- `src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx` — navy CTA pattern (reuse for demo-audience)
- `src/components/how-it-works/agency-fit.tsx` — card grid pattern
- `src/components/ui/input.tsx` and `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx` — form primitives
